quotes.text: Two years of downtime are enough! We can't take being stuck in the rehearsal room any longer! Since our last shows in August '23 in Blackpool and Zurich, we've recharged our batteries and written new songs. Now the hunger for live shows is so strong that we're heading back out this summer. Staying true to the old Geier Sturzflug motto, 'Visit Europe while it's still standing,' we'll be heading to a handful of our favorite cities. When we get back in the ring starting August 29th, 2025 in Copenhagen, Stockholm, Warsaw, London, Paris, Amsterdam, and Brussels, it won't be sparring – it'll be full contact. We're looking forward to meeting lots of old and new friends and hopefully having a few great adventures. We're excited to see everyone who comes out and joins us!
